snippet.title: Portal 2: Project Capture - Act 1 Finale Gameplay
snippet.description:
Get a sneak peek at the final puzzle of Act 1 in the Portal 2 mod, Project Capture! This gameplay teaser shows off the challenging conclusion to the first act. Please note that voice acting is still a work in progress.

Our resources: https://lavashik.dev/PCapture
Discord server: https://discord.gg/WUgNnJcs7p

A CropFactor Team Production
